verdict.rationale: The official CLI documents an explicit `skills update` command that updates all installed skills, one named skill, or several named skills to their latest versions. It also documents symlink installs for 'easy updates', so fixes arrive without reinstalling from scratch. Community complaints that updates are undocumented are general skepticism, not a hands-on failure, and the README contradicts them. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration that the update command works, and deeper docs on update behavior (e.g., version pinning, lockfile interaction).

support.subject: As a developer, there is a documented update path — marketplace auto-updates or an explicit update command — so I get fixes without reinstalling from scratch

citations.quote: Update installed skills to latest versions

npx skills update

# Update a single skill by name
npx skills update my-skill
`skills update [skills...]` | Update skills to latest versions
Creates symlinks from each agent to a canonical copy. Single source of truth, easy updates.
